title: Bro
body: It’s amazing. It’s simple and tasteful. If there would be some subs I wouldn’t use it, but I could buy it for 5-10 bucks if it provided the full experience forever
author: Yushewitz

title: Не хватает создания уникальных привычек
body: Приложение - то, что искала! Минималистично дизайн, удобное, интуитивно понятное, легко настраиваемое. Но очень не хватает возможность создать свою привычку дополнительно к выбору из представленных.
author: дк12345

title: Simple and good
body: I don’t remember where i heard about this app but this the only one habit tracker that have worked for me. I think it’s because you can see your previous successful days (and skipped too). Thanks to creators :)
author: xiiserane01

title: Хорошо
body: Приложение настоящая находка, мне нравится, хотелось бы только еще возможность менять цвет виджетов

title: Good
body: Good so far. Thanks for the free access. Would like to have the possibility to create habits without a number of days, just habits without an end. Also, widgets would be super to have 🥹

title: THE Best daily routine tracker
body:
Pros: 
- Wonderful UI
- Has focus mode and a journal if u need it
- Easy to see your streaks 
- Unlimited habits for FREE

Cons: 
Actually none, but it would’ve been perfect if there was a different mode where u can not fully complete a task for a day

Thank you for your work!
